issues.description: In problem_statement.md, the UML diagram declares Lecture.getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type void, but the task text requires it to return a String (format: "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)") and the reference solution implements it as returning String. Students following the UML literally would implement the wrong method signature and fail compilation/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the UML signature in problem_statement.md to "+getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String" so it matches the task description and the solution implementation.
